insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (varies as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: If the Policy Sum Insured along with accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), Super No Claim Bonus (if any), is completely exhausted or is insufficient for covering a claim as a result of previous claims, then We shall provide for a refill of the Sum Insured, unlimited times during the Policy Year... The Refill of Sum Insured shall be available for all subsequent claims also and to any Illness / Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted
great.explanation: Provides an unlimited refill of Sum Insured during the policy year once the base Sum Insured (plus NCB/Super NCB, if any) is exhausted or insufficient. The refill can be used for subsequent claims even for the same illness/injury and its complications.

great.name: NCB
great.quote: We shall apply a cumulative bonus in the form of No Claim Bonus at such 10% of the Sum Insured of the expiring policy year... The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 100% of the Sum Insured... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by the percentage of Sum Insured as accumulated in the previous Policy Year
great.explanation: Gives a 10% No Claim Bonus each claim-free year up to a maximum of 100% of Sum Insured. If you claim, the accumulated bonus reduces by the last year’s accumulated percentage instead of resetting to zero.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from the policy start date, but accidents are covered from day 1. This is a standard waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with Us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 (Code-Excl02) Specified disease / procedure waiting period
good.explanation: Listed diseases/procedures are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage from the first policy inception with the insurer. This delays coverage for those conditions even if you are otherwise covered for hospitalization.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the Sum Insured as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home treatment (domiciliary hospitalization) is covered up to the Sum Insured as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. This helps when hospitalization is not possible and treatment is medically required at home.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent for accommodation in Hospital room and other boarding charges up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy;
bad.explanation: Room rent is payable only up to limits mentioned in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table, not at actuals. If your plan has a room cap, choosing a higher room category can increase out-of-pocket costs (including possible proportionate deductions).

unclear.name: PED Waiting Period
unclear.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of months as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy of continuous coverage
unclear.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered until a waiting period shown in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table is completed. The exact duration is not stated in the provided text, so you must check your schedule to know whether it is 24/36/48 months etc.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover... for the number of days in accordance with the limits specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C.I (d) Pre – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for a number of days as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. The exact day limit is not visible here, so your out-of-pocket depends on what your schedule states.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover... for the number of days specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C.I (e) Post – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for a number of days as per the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table. The exact day limit is not visible here, so you need to confirm it in your schedule.
